review_evidence: README identifies Loogle as a search tool/backend for Lean and Mathlib, with indexing, cache, parser, CLI, web-service, and editor-integration functionality.

Production modules implement declaration indexing/matching/search and contain no independent proposition development; the apparent theorem surface is confined to Tests.lean and tiny lake-execution fixtures used to test search behavior.
The test propositions are query/index fixtures (for example my_true_eq_true and non_linear_pattern_test*) rather than a mathematical development or verified semantics of the search algorithm.

source_action.content_invariant: The hydrated repository is search-engine implementation and search-regression fixtures; it does not provide an independent mathematical or verified-semantics formalization corpus.
